CARR local citation integration
==============================

citeproc-js
-----------
Copyright (c) 2009-2019 Frank Bennett.
Project: https://github.com/Juris-M/citeproc-js
The unmodified citeproc.js file is taken from commit
56e7ef310154748368665cc8a2be124e3c141832.
Its upstream dual-license notice is preserved as LICENSE. This distribution
chooses the Common Public Attribution License 1.0 (CPAL-1.0) option.
The complete CPAL and alternative AGPL texts accompany this source file.
The wrapper and application code are separate from the unmodified processor.

Citation Style Language styles and locales
-----------------------------------------
Styles and locales are from the Citation Style Language project:
https://citationstyles.org/
https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles
https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales
They retain their upstream XML author/contributor, title, source and rights
metadata and are distributed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike
3.0 Unported. The full license is included as LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt.
These local copies have no intentional formatting-rule changes; a terminal
newline may have been normalized during retrieval.
UPSTREAM.json records each project's commit and every installed asset SHA256.

Runtime
-------
Node.js is a separately installed local runtime and is not part of these
vendored sources. No automatic runtime, style, locale or model download occurs.
